verses.en: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.sm: Lo‘u atalii e, afai ua fai oe ma moni o lau uo; afai ua fetagofi i lima mo le tagata ese,

verses.en: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.sm: ua maileia oe i upu a lou gutu; ua maua oe i upu a lou gutu.

verses.en: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.sm: O lenei, lo‘u atalii e, ia e faia le mea nei, ina ia laveaiina oe, pe a oo mai le pule a lau uo ia te oe; alu ia, ina ifo, ma e nati atu i lau uo;

verses.en: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.sm: aua ne‘i moe ou mata, pe tulemoe ou laumata;

verses.en: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.sm: ia e laveaiina oe e oe, e pei o le sevi ai le lima; e pei o le manu foi ai le lima o le fai manu.

verses.en: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.sm: Le paie e, ina e alu i le loi, ia vaavaai i lana amio, ina ia poto ai oe;

verses.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.sm: e leai sona ta'ita'i, po o se leoleo, po o sé pule,

verses.en: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.sm: a e saunia e ia ana mea e “ai ile tausaga vevela, ma faaputuina ana mea e ‘ai i ona po e selesele ai saito.

verses.en: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.sm: Le paie e, e te taoto seia afea? Seʻi e tulai afea ai lou moe?

verses.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.sm: to Seʻi toe itiiti sina moe, toe itiiti se matamoe, toe itiiti se piilima e taoto ai,

verses.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.sm: a e oo mai lou mativa e pei o le malaga; ma lou le tagolima pei o le tagata ua sauni lana auupega.

verses.en: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.sm: O le tagata ulavale, o le tagata agasala, o loo savali ia ma le gutu faapiopio;

verses.en: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.sm: E genogeno ona mata; e tautalatala ona vae; e faasino i ona tamatamai lima.

verses.en: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.sm: Ua i lona loto le faapiopio; na te fai togafiti leaga i aso uma; na te faatupuina maseiga;

verses.en: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.sm: 0 le mea lea e faafuasei ai ona oo mai o lona malaia; e faafuasei ona nutimomoia o ia, a e leai se fofo.

verses.en: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
verses.sm: O mea nei e ono ua inosia e le ALII; o lona fitu foi ua matua inosia lava e ia;

verses.en: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.sm: 0 mata faasiasia, o le laulaufaiva pepelo, ma lima e sasaa le toto o le ua le sala,

verses.en: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.sm: o le loto e manatunatu i togafiti leaga, o vae e tele vavave ona taufetuli i le leaga,

verses.en: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.sm: o le molimau pepelo, na te tautala i mea pepelo; ma le na te faatupu maseiga i uso.

verses.en: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.sm: Lo'u atalii e, ia e tausi i poloaiga a lou tama; aua foi e te tuulafoaiina le upu e aʻoaʻo atu a lou tina;

verses.en: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
verses.sm: ia fusi ai e le aunoa i lou loto; ia asoa ai i lou ua.

verses.en: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.sm: A e savali, e ta‘itai‘ina ai oe; a E moe, e leoleoina ai oe; a è ala, e tautala ai ma oe.

verses.en: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.sm: Ana o le poloaiga o le: sulu lea; ma le upu e aʻoaʻo atu, o le malamalama lea; o aoaiga foi e aʻoaʻoina ai, o le ala o le ola lea,

verses.en: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.sm: ina ia leoleo ia te oe ai le fafine amio leaga, ai le laulaufaiva molemole o le fafine ese.

verses.en: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi naunau lou loto i lona lalelei; aua neʻi maua oe i ona laumata.

verses.en: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.sm: Auā e iu ina toe na o si fasi areto ona o le fafine talitane; o le avā foi a le tasi tagata na te taumailei le ola aoga.

verses.en: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.sm: E ave ea e se tasi le afi i lona fatafata, a e le mu ai ona ofu?

verses.en: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.sm: Afai e savali se tagata i luga o malala ola, e le mu ai ea ona vae?

verses.en: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.sm: E faapea foi le ua alu atu i le avá a le la te tuaoi; ai se tago ia te ia, e le faasaoina o ia.

verses.en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.sm: E le inosia le gaoi pe a gaoi o ia e tali ai lona manava, ina ua fia ‘ai;

verses.en: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.sm: a e a maua o ia, ona taui atu lea e ia e taifitu; na te avatu ai oloa uma o i lona fale.

verses.en: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.sm: O lē mulilua i le fafine ua leai sona mafaufau; o le na te faia lea mea, na te faaumatia e ia lona lava ola;

verses.en: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.sm: na te maua le fasiga ma le faamaina; o lona luma foi e le sóloiesea lea,

verses.en: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.sm: Auā o le fuā o le ita tele lea o le tagata; na te le faasaoina foi o ia i le aso e taui ai ma sui.

verses.en: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.sm: Na te le talia se togiola lava; na te le mafaia foi, e ui lava ina ua e faatele ni mea e avatu
